state.on_never: On · until you turn it off
mode.system_hint: No sleep. The screen turns off as usual.
mode.display_hint: No sleep, and the screen stays on.
reason.never: Moka: awake until you turn it off
popover.welcome_title: Moka lives here, in the taskbar
popover.welcome_body: If you can't see its icon next to the clock, it's among the hidden icons (the ^ arrow): drag it out to keep it one click away.
settings.title: Settings
settings.autostart: Start Moka when I sign in to Windows
settings.autostart_hint: It stays in the taskbar, without opening any window.
settings.left_click_toggle: Turns it on or off with the last choice
settings.left_click_hint: Right-click always opens the full menu.
settings.durations_hint: Separated by commas, for example 15m, 45m, 1h30m. Up to 6.
settings.durations_invalid: I don't understand “{value}”. Use minutes and hours, for example 45m or 1h30m.
settings.privacy: Everything stays on your PC: no account, no cloud, no telemetry.
lid.question_title: Keep the laptop on with the lid closed too?
lid.question_body: To do it, Moka briefly changes the Windows setting “When I close the lid”, and always puts it back as it was.
lid.desk: Desk mode: with an external monitor connected, closing the lid never puts the PC to sleep
settings.lid_intro: During a session, closing the lid:
settings.lid_windows: the PC goes to sleep, as usual
settings.lid_ac: it stays on, only while plugged in
settings.lid_always: it stays on, on battery too
settings.backpack: On battery with no external monitor, after
settings.backpack_hint: do what Windows would have done: it protects a laptop closed in a bag.
settings.desk_mode: Desk mode: with an external monitor connected, a closed lid never puts the PC to sleep, even without a session
settings.lock_on_open: Lock the PC when I open the lid
settings.windows_now: Windows setting: {ac} when plugged in, {dc} on battery.
settings.windows_held: Right now Moka has set it to “Do nothing”: it will go back to how it was at the end.
settings.lid_policy: This setting is managed by your organization: Moka won't change it.
settings.lid_shared: Power plans apply to the whole PC: while Moka holds the change, other users also find the lid set to “Do nothing”.
settings.battery_threshold: Turn Moka off when the battery drops to
settings.battery_hint: Only on battery. A session started with the battery already below the threshold isn't interrupted.
notify.battery_body: Battery at {percent}%: the PC is back to its usual behavior.
toast.countdown_rule: The rule “{rule}” no longer keeps the PC on.
toast.warning_body: Then the PC goes back to its usual behavior.
popover.update_later: Updates once the session is off
popover.star_body: A star on GitHub helps other people find it.
update.session_active: Moka updates once the session is off: it would stop halfway.
settings.warn_hint: With a “+30 min” button. Only for sessions longer than 10 minutes.
settings.shortcut_error: Not available, another app already uses it: {keys}
settings.update_none: You already have the latest version.
settings.update_hint: Moka checks on its own once a day: it's the only time it goes online.
notify.while_body: {name} isn't running, so Moka isn't waiting for it.
popover.pause_title: Moka is on because of a rule
popover.pause_body: Right now {reason}. If you turn it off, the rule turns it back on in a few seconds, so pause the rules instead.
settings.rules_intro: Moka turns itself on when needed and off when it's no longer needed. It checks every 5 seconds, without connecting to anything.
settings.rule_program_hint: The file name, like obs64.exe. The list shows the programs open right now.
settings.rule_too_many: You've reached the maximum number of rules.
settings.rule_duplicate: This rule already exists: change that one.
settings.rule_same_time: Start and end can't be the same.
settings.rule_kind_call: In a call (microphone or webcam in use)
settings.rule_network_hint: The name as Windows shows it in Settings → Network & internet, Wi-Fi or cable. The list shows the networks you're connected to right now.
settings.presence: Stay present while Moka is on
settings.presence_hint: After a minute without input, Moka presses F15, a key that doesn't exist on common keyboards: no screen saver, no idle lock, no "away" on Teams or Slack.
settings.presence_warning: The idle lock exists for security: on work PCs this option may break company rules.
settings.section_diagnose: Why won't it sleep? Why did it wake up?
settings.diagnose_intro: Moka reads what Windows already knows and explains it in plain words. It doesn't change anything.
settings.diagnose_who_hint: Windows only tells an administrator: its confirmation prompt will appear.
settings.diagnose_requests_none: No program is asking to keep it awake.
settings.diagnose_timers: Wake timers, as Windows lists them
settings.diagnose_rests_empty: Windows hasn't recorded any standby or sleep.
settings.diagnose_devices_hint: To take the permission away from a device: Device Manager → the device → Properties → Power Management.
diag.rest_audio: Low power for {pct}% of the time: audio was playing.
diag.rest_active: Low power for {pct}% of the time: something kept it active.
diag.woke_input: you used the keyboard, mouse or touchpad
diag.woke_power_source: the charger was plugged in or unplugged
diag.woke_app_display: a program asked to turn the screen back on
diag.woke_battery: a battery was connected or disconnected
diag.woke_device: a device was connected or disconnected
diag.entered_screen_off: because a program turned off the screen
diag.entered_battery: because the battery was nearly empty
diag.now_moka_session: Moka is keeping it awake: a session is on.
diag.now_moka_rules: Moka is keeping it awake because {reasons}.
diag.now_others: Another program is asking to keep it awake: “Show who keeps it awake” tells you which.
diag.now_others_display: Another program is asking to keep the screen on: “Show who keeps it awake” tells you which.
diag.now_nobody: No program is asking to keep it awake right now.
diag.now_never: Windows is set to never put it to sleep: Settings → System → Power.
diag.now_sleep_after: With no activity, Windows puts it to sleep after {time}.
diag.now_never_ac: When plugged in, Windows never puts it to sleep: Settings → System → Power & battery.
diag.now_sleep_after_ac: When plugged in, with no activity, it goes to sleep after {time}.
diag.now_never_dc: On battery, Windows never puts it to sleep: Settings → System → Power & battery.
diag.now_sleep_after_dc: On battery, with no activity, it goes to sleep after {time}.
diag.now_presence: Presence is on: to Windows you're never idle.
diag.now_audio: In the last standbys it stayed active because audio was open, even muted: a browser tab, a player, a call, a program holding the audio open.
diag.now_modern: This PC uses modern standby: with the screen off it stays connected and can wake up on its own for short moments.
diag.timers_on: Wake timers are on: an update or a scheduled task can turn it on.
diag.timers_important: Wake timers: only important ones, like update restarts.
diag.req_away: keeps the PC in away mode
diag.hint_audio: Usually open audio, even muted: a browser tab, a player, a call.
diag.hint_browser: A tab is playing video or audio, or is in a call.
diag.admin_cancelled: Without administrator permission Windows doesn't say who keeps it awake.
